exceptions.rationale: ROCm SDPA kernel dispatch and capability fencing are still colocated; this exact cap prevents growth pending a backend-owned split.
Embedded Metal shader source is generated-style backend material rather than orchestration; its exact physical-line count is nevertheless capped against growth.
The inference state machine still combines prefill, decode, cache, and sampling orchestration; splitting it requires preserving request-lifecycle invariants.
ROCm graph admission, capture, replay, telemetry, and recovery share one safety authority today; this exception is a strict non-growth ceiling.
Resident Vulkan decode owns tightly coupled shader state and lifecycle validation; this exact ceiling forbids further consolidation into the file.
The training HTTP surface still combines several method schemas and handlers; the cap prevents growth until those API behaviors receive child modules.
The sole production scheduler intentionally owns one state machine, but its policy and resource helpers still need reviewed extraction before this exception can shrink.
The command-line product currently centralizes command schemas and dispatch; this non-growth cap requires new command families to use owned modules.
Typed configuration is deliberately canonical and self-documenting, but parsing, validation, and schema projection must not expand this file beyond the reviewed cap.
Application state still owns multiple cache and memory authorities; this cap blocks new ownership domains until existing state is split deliberately.
Training admission, execution, and publication are coupled by transactional invariants; the exception permits no growth while those owners are separated.
CUDA storage and operation dispatch remain coupled to backend resource ownership; this reviewed ceiling prevents further unrelated backend behavior here.
On-policy distillation still combines data flow, resume, teacher, and optimization orchestration; this cap forbids growth pending method-owned modules.
This file is the centralized generated-style Vulkan kernel registry and embedded shader source authority; additions must remain within its reviewed ceiling.
